optimizerProfile.taskGoal: Complete all requested actions using official discovered tools and observations.
inputFeatures: Multi-step service tasks, endpoint discovery, field/path/body contracts and actual world effects.
knownErrors: Wrong attribute or argument placement, repeated failed searches, omitted associations/notifications, premature done.

recommended.reason: Choose discovered official calls, consume their observations and track unfinished requested actions.
Retain action dependencies and success/error observations within one task.

notDefault.capability: Done marker or official score as completion proof
notDefault.reason: A high-scoring deal creation omitted the requested contact association; actual observations must support every action.

notDefault.capability: Private world assertions or modified scoring
notDefault.reason: Evaluator-only; the official grader stays unchanged.

directions: Plan requested actions, execute dependency order, observe errors, check remaining actions from public evidence.
outputAndCompletion: Preserve fixed JSON decision contract and tool schema; done requires observed completion of all requested actions.
costAndLimits: Use only host-registered tools and targets under the approved per-task limits; arbitrary network, shell and private evaluator access are forbidden.
Official service calls are permitted only through the existing controlled api_search/api_fetch adapters.
optimizerProfile.adviceStatus: Unvalidated Graph design hypotheses; recommended capabilities and organization are not measured improvements.

evidence.positive: Baseline 195/200 retained; several field-mapping changes had real improvements.
evidence.negative: Numeric best 198/200 rejected because the required association remained absent after failed calls; final new candidate 197/200.
evidence.limitation: No optimizer strategy selected; task repetition 196/200 was only a single exploration result, not adopted.

researchMetadata.validation: Selected seed measured on Search; initialization advice not yet quality-tested. Strategies are transferred initialization assets; measured results do not establish performance on the current team backend.
